title: Apache IoTDB
summary: Apache IoTDB is an open-source Java time series database designed for IoT and industrial internet of things scenarios. It stores data in the TsFile columnar format built on LSM-Trees, supporting flexible deployment from edge devices to cloud clusters. Key features include high compression, high-throughput ingestion, time-based querying, and integration with machine learning via AINode. It supports edge-cloud synchronization and connectors for Hadoop/Spark processing.

mechanisms.title: TsFile Columnar Storage Format
mechanisms.explanation: TsFile is a columnar compact file format developed for time series data. Its structure is based on the Log-structured merge-tree (LSM-Tree), which reduces computational resource usage and optimizes performance for storage and retrieval within Apache IoTDB.

mechanisms.title: Edge-Cloud Cooperation via Synchronization
mechanisms.explanation: IoTDB supports edge-cloud cooperation by synchronizing data between IoTDB instances at user-configured intervals using a Sync Tool, allowing data collected close to devices to be synchronized to a central system.
